screens.title: Host profile · Quick Actions
screens.purpose: The host's own profile with the Quick Actions icon grid.

screens.title: Host · Services list
screens.purpose: Host manages services; each card opens Edit; "New service" starts with a video.

screens.title: Host · Add a video (service)
screens.purpose: Pick one clip from the gallery (no recording, no editing).

screens.title: Host · Service details (create)
screens.purpose: Everything the customer sees on the video: name, description, price, duration, people, included, not included, not allowed, who does it.

screens.title: Host · Edit service (no video yet)
screens.purpose: Same fields as create; Add video tile; delete in the header.

screens.title: Host · Rooms list
screens.purpose: Accommodation host manages rooms.

screens.title: Host · Add a video (room)
screens.purpose: Pick one clip that shows the room.

screens.title: Host · Room details (create)
screens.purpose: Name, description, price per night, guests, included, not included, not allowed.

screens.title: Host · Edit room (no video yet)
screens.purpose: Same fields as create; Add video tile; delete in the header.

screens.title: Host · Team
screens.purpose: Everyone who works with the host, grouped Active / Paused / Invites; one Invite to team button.

screens.title: Host · Invite to team (sheet)
screens.purpose: Search by username; Invite / Invited states; they join after they accept.

screens.title: Host · Team member
screens.purpose: Status (Active / Paused), the services they do, remove from team, Save changes.

screens.title: Host · Customers · People
screens.purpose: Customers who booked in the app, filtered by group; pick people; one Send reward button.

screens.title: Host · New reward (by hand)
screens.purpose: Who it goes to, live ticket preview, discount, message (40 chars), valid for.

screens.title: Host · Reward sent
screens.purpose: Confirmation with the ticket; See rewards or Done.

screens.title: Host · Customers · Rewards
screens.purpose: Automatic rules with on/off, an idea to start, and the rewards sent this month with "Used by".

screens.title: Host · New automatic reward · When
screens.purpose: Pick the first send on the week strip; it repeats every month on that day.

screens.title: Host · New automatic reward · Who
screens.purpose: Visits in the month before the send (exactly / or more), how often a person can get it, skip unused.

screens.title: Host · New automatic reward · Reward
screens.purpose: Ticket preview, message (40 chars), discount, valid for.

screens.title: Host · New automatic reward · Check and turn on
screens.purpose: The rule as one sentence, When / Who / Reward with Change, Turn on.

screens.title: Host · Edit automatic reward
screens.purpose: On/off, results, ticket, rule rows to change, delete, Save changes.

screens.title: Host · Reward details
screens.purpose: Ticket, Sent / Used / Not used yet, who used it, Stop reward.

screens.title: Host · Reservations tab
screens.purpose: Requests banner on top, then today and tomorrow (time, name, what · people, status).

screens.title: Host · Requests to answer
screens.purpose: Oldest first; each card shows the date, time, who, what · people, chips, note, and Decline / Accept.

screens.title: Host · Reservation request
screens.purpose: Everything about one request: summary, offer used, customer with call / copy email, special requests, Decline / Accept.

screens.title: Host · Decline (reason sheet)
screens.purpose: Two reasons only: Fully booked or Closed that day; red Decline request.

screens.title: Host · Reservation confirmed
screens.purpose: Accepted banner, the confirmed reservation, customer, Cancel reservation.

screens.title: Host · After the visit
screens.purpose: Did they come? No-show / Yes, done; done by itself the next day.

screens.title: Customer · My activity · Upcoming
screens.purpose: Tabs Upcoming / Rewards / History; upcoming reservations by day with Confirmed / Waiting.

screens.title: Customer · My activity · Rewards
screens.purpose: Rewards ready to use (open the reward), then used or ended in grey.

screens.title: Customer · My activity · History
screens.purpose: Past reservations by month: Rate, your rating, or Book again after a decline / cancel.

screens.title: Customer · Reservation · waiting
screens.purpose: Waiting for the place to answer: summary with the offer, place (copy address, call), special requests, Cancel request.

screens.title: Customer · Reservation · confirmed
screens.purpose: Confirmed banner, summary, place (copy address, call), Cancel reservation.

screens.title: Customer · Reward
screens.purpose: The ticket, who it is from, days left, single use, Book with <place>.

screens.title: Public · Search · Before you type
screens.purpose: Empty search field and recent searches (remove one, Clear all); tap a recent search to run it again.

screens.title: Public · Search · No results
screens.purpose: Nothing matches the words: the query repeated and a hint to check the spelling or use fewer words.

screens.title: Public · Search · All
screens.purpose: Tabs All / Videos / Places / Deals; All is one mixed feed of places, videos (2 per row) and deals (2 per row) that keeps loading.

screens.title: Public · Search · Videos tab
screens.purpose: Only videos, 2 per row, the place name under the title; keeps loading.

screens.title: Public · Search · Places tab
screens.purpose: Only places: initial, name, verified, kind · city, opening status; keeps loading.

screens.title: Public · Search · Deals tab
screens.purpose: Coupons and events, 2 per row, filter All / Events / Coupons; a tap opens the booking with the deal picked.

screens.title: Profile · New post · Pick a video
screens.purpose: The + button opens the gallery: pick one clip (up to 100 MB), then Next. No Skip: a post needs a video.

screens.title: Profile · New post · On the video, empty
screens.purpose: The whole video with an empty title (0 / 30) and description (0 / 100) where people will read them; Tag on the side rail; Publish greyed until there is a title.

screens.title: Profile · New post · Written and tagged
screens.purpose: Title and description at their caps (30 / 100), the Tag icon white with a badge (1 tag), Publish.

screens.title: Profile · New post · Tag a place (sheet)
screens.purpose: Tag a place, a service or a room: search places, or one tap on a visit (the place and what was booked there); Done.

screens.title: Public · Accommodation profile · Rooms
screens.purpose: Customer view of an accommodation: About (map), Call, rooms grid.

screens.title: Public · Room video
screens.purpose: Full-screen room video: Call on the side rail, info bar, included chips.

screens.title: Public · Room · What is included (sheet)
screens.purpose: Full list over the video: included (grouped), not included, not allowed.

screens.title: Public · Services profile
screens.purpose: Customer view of a salon/barber: About, Book now, services grid.

screens.title: Public · Food & Beverage profile
screens.purpose: Header + About + Book now only (no content tabs).

screens.title: Regular · Services (stylist picked)
screens.purpose: Team filter on a stylist: only their services; others greyed.

screens.title: Regular · Service video
screens.purpose: Book on the side rail goes straight to the calendar.

screens.title: Regular · Pick a time
screens.purpose: Picked stylist highlighted, replacements visible, earliest time preselected.

screens.title: Service · What is included (sheet)
screens.purpose: Opened from "+8 more" on R2/F2.

screens.title: First visit · Services (Everyone)
screens.purpose: All services; stylists greyed.

screens.title: First visit · Service video
screens.purpose: Book on the side rail opens Choose a stylist.

screens.title: First visit · Choose a stylist
screens.purpose: Anyone or a stylist, with role, specialties, rating, languages, next free.

screens.title: First visit · Pick a time · Any time
screens.purpose: Who and When as R3, plus Choose an offer (Any time selected) and all free times.

screens.title: First visit · Pick a time · coupon offer
screens.purpose: Coupon chosen: only its time windows, each with the green "15% OFF" sticker.

screens.title: First visit · Pick a time · event offer
screens.purpose: Event chosen: its spots (start – end, spots left) instead of times.

screens.title: Public · Coupons & Events tab
screens.purpose: Ticket cards, 3 per row, photo-tile filter.

screens.title: Book a table · 1 · Pick a date
screens.purpose: Month calendar tinted by availability + the month's events & coupons list.

screens.title: Book a table · 2 · Guests & time · Any time
screens.purpose: When week strip, guests stepper, Choose an offer (Any time), all Lunch and Dinner times.

screens.title: Book a table · 2 · Guests & time · coupon
screens.purpose: Coupon chosen: only its time windows, each with the green "20% OFF" sticker.

screens.title: Book a table · 2 · Guests & time · event
screens.purpose: Event chosen: its sittings (start – end, seats left) instead of times.

screens.title: Book a table · 3 · Your details · Any time
screens.purpose: Summary (day tile, time, guests, length) + first/last name, phone, email, requests.

screens.title: Book a table · 3 · Your details · coupon
screens.purpose: Same form; the summary ends with the green coupon strip (final reminder).

screens.title: Book a table · 3 · Your details · event
screens.purpose: Same form; the summary ends with the purple event strip (sitting, seats held).

screens.title: Book a table · 4 · Booked
screens.purpose: Confirmation: summary, address (copy), call, Add to calendar, Done.
